p: First time on an indoor track? Here are a few things that'll help you get the most out of your session. Look ahead through the corners, not at the kart in front. Your hands follow your eyes, so look where you want to end up.
Brake before you turn rather than halfway round the bend, and ease back on the throttle as you straighten up. Try not to use both pedals at once; it slows you down more than you'd think.
Sit right back in the seat and keep your grip relaxed. The steering on a kart is direct and can be heavy, so tense arms will tire quickly.
And don't forget, everyone gets quicker as the session goes on. If your first few laps feel slow, that's normal. Build up gradually and you'll soon be chasing down the drivers in front.
Clydebank has its own railway station with regular trains into Glasgow, which makes it easy for a group to get there without anyone having to drive.

If you're making a party of it, agree on a little prize for the winner beforehand. A chocolate trophy or the loser buying the chips does wonders for the competitive spirit. Most of all, have fun and enjoy the race.
